title: Open Science packages local agents, notebooks and provenance into one workbench
friendlyTitle: Keep AI research, notebooks and evidence together on your computer
summary: Open Science by AIPOCH is an Apache-2.0, local-first research workbench with model-agnostic agents, Python and R notebooks, data connectors and provenance records. The approximately 3,800-star desktop project is under active development across Windows, macOS and Linux.
friendlySummary: Open Science combines research agents, Python and R notebooks, data connections and records of where results came from. It works locally and can use different AI models.
whyItMatters: Researchers can keep data, analysis code, agent work and evidence in one inspectable environment instead of scattering them across chat sessions and notebook services. Treat it as an actively changing tool: test recovery, connectors and reproducibility on non-critical work before adopting it for important research.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Researchers can keep more of a project in one place and inspect how a result was produced. Test it on low-risk work first because the project is changing quickly.
